snippet.title: MINIKIN - Official Teaser | A Multiplayer Hidden Object Game
snippet.description:
The satisfying feeling of finding hidden objects can now be shared with your friends! ✨
👇 The first step of this journey is to Wishlist MINIKIN on Steam:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4531600/MINIKIN/

In this teaser, you get your first glimpse of MINIKIN, a multiplayer hidden-object game for 1 to 4 players. We took that cozy, highly satisfying mechanic of "spotting things" and brought it to game night! Play cooperatively to clear the board together, or jump into friendly competition to see who has the sharpest eyes.

Since we are a small indie studio (hello from Mirim!), your Wishlist click is the absolute best way to help us get noticed by the Steam algorithm. Wishlist the game today and help us make a splash at the upcoming Steam Hidden Object Fest starting April 9th! 🕵️‍♂️✨

What to expect in the full game:
👀 Play Together: Short, fun matches (5 to 10 minutes) to play online or locally with your friends.
✨ Always Fresh: Our boards are procedural. The magic is that you will never play the exact same match twice!
🤝 Play Your Way: Work together in Co-op to find every item, or show off your speed in our friendly competitive modes.
🏆 Collect & Customize: Earn coins in every match to unlock cute new Archetypes, collectible stickers, and customizations in Stickerland.

Keep an eye on our socials and join our community to follow the development:
👾 Discord: https://discord.gg/v7qWzW8DUu
🐦 X / Twitter: https://x.com/hey_mirim

A game by Mirim.

#Minikin #IndieGame #CozyGames #HiddenObject #Multiplayer #Steam
